g.text: fanout-solver: a reserved ground plane blocks via-site assignment
Blue: top SIGNAL pad. Light orange: returned candidates. Dark orange: selected site.
Red: inner1 GND reserved obstacle. Both TSX boards contain GND; only unbroken changes.
Expected: a SIGNAL via can cross inner1 on its way to inner2, with a copper-free ring in GND.
Actual: viaSiteClearsObstacles rejects every candidate inside the reserved pour region.
Direct helper output only. No dogbone-solver dependency, saved routes, routed copper, or antipad output.
